data.name: Rayhaanat
data.gender_notes: Rayhaanat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rayhaanat is an Arabic name for girls meaning 'Gentle Flowers'. It is a beautiful name inspired by the blooming flowers which symbolize grace, beauty, and gentle strength. The name Rayhaanat carries the meaning “Gentle Flowers” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rayhaanat usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle flowers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Rayhaanat is believed to have spiritual meanings in Islamic traditions. It is associated with the idea of divine guidance and protection, as well as the concept of the beauty and grace of nature.
data.etymology: Rayhaanat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle Flowers.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rayhaanat total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: ريحانة
in_arabic.meaning: ريحانة تعني الوردة الجميلة والمحبوبة في الجنة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ريحانة مشتق من كلمة ريحان، وهي نوع من أنواع النباتات ذات الرائحة الجميلة، وردت في القرآن الكريم في سورة يس، الآية 11، وتعني الوردة الجميلة والمحبوبة في الجنة، وتدل على الجمال والروحانية

in_urdu.name: ریحانہ
in_urdu.meaning: ریحانہ خوبصورت اور محبوبہ جنت کی وردہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام ريحانہ عربی زبان کی جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوشبو دار پودا، جو جنت میں پائے جانے والے پودوں کی یاد دلاتا ہے، اور اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا ذکر خاص اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر سورہ يس میں

in_hindi.name: ریحانہ
in_hindi.meaning: ريحانة जन्नत की सुंदर और प्रिय पुष्प
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम रिहाना अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सुगंधित पौधा, जो स्वर्ग में पाए जाने वाले पौधों की याद दिलाता है, और इस्लामी परंपरा में इसकी विशेष महत्ता है, खासकर सूरह यासीन में

in_pashto.name: ريحانہ
in_pashto.meaning: ريحانہ د جنت ښکلې او محبوبې ګل
in_pashto.long_meaning: د ريحانې نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د خوشبو لرونکي نبات په معنا دی، دا نبات د جنت د نباتاتو يادونه کوي، او په اسلامي دوديزۍ کې يې ځانګړې اهميت لري، په ځانګړي ډول د ياسين سورت کې

in_english.name: Rayhaanat
in_english.meaning: Beautiful and beloved flower of paradise
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rayhaanat originates from the Arabic root 'r-ḥ-n', meaning fragrant plant, which symbolizes the beauty and spirituality of paradise, referenced in the Quran, Surah Yasin, verse 11, signifying a lovely and cherished entity in Islamic tradition

It is a name that evokes refinement and grace, conveying a positive and feminine image. The use of such a name in various Islamic cultures highlights the importance of valuing the grace and beauty of women, both within and without.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, Rayhaanat signifies a gentle soul, one that radiates peace and tranquility, like a blooming flower spreading its fragrance. This name also emphasizes the concept of being a ray of hope, light, and positivity in the lives of others, just as a flower inspires joy and happiness. Thus, the spiritual significance of the name Rayhaanat encourages a gentle, graceful, and hopeful spirit, one that nurtures growth and inspires joy and positivity in the hearts of those around.
